transcript.content: Hello, I’m glad you came in today. What brings you in today?

Hi, thank you for seeing me. My mood has been all over the place lately and I feel constantly revved up and on edge, like I can’t shut myself off. It’s just getting to be too much and I feel really overwhelmed.
How long have you been feeling this way, and did it start after a specific stressful event or change in your life?

These intense, revved-up feelings have been going on for about a month now. It all started when my parents began pushing me to move back home to help care for an ailing relative, right when I was trying to focus on getting a shift-supervisor promotion at my job.
During this month, have you had times when you needed much less sleep than usual and still felt unusually energetic or overly confident, or were you more just anxious and overwhelmed?

Honestly, I feel a mix of both. I swing into feeling on top of the world with this wired energy where I'm cleaning the apartment at 2 a.m. or starting big business plans, but then I'll get completely anxious and overwhelmed. Even though my brain is buzzing and I can't sleep, I don't feel refreshed—my body is literally shaking from tiredness, but I just can't shut the motor off.

Have you also had periods of feeling unusually confident or irritable with racing thoughts, talking more than usual, spending more money, or doing risky things that other people noticed as out of character?

Yes, I swing from feeling on top of the world to snapping at everyone, and my thoughts crash into each other so fast that I can't focus. I've been talking so fast that people at work and home have to tell me to slow down, and I'm running around nonstop taking extra shifts and trying to start a family business.

Have these high-energy periods lasted most of the day nearly every day for at least a week, and during them have you felt unusually confident or done things like spending a lot of money, taking risks, or acting in ways others said were out of character?

Yes, this high-energy, revved-up feeling has been going on almost constantly for about a month. During these times, I felt incredibly driven to fix everything, taking on extra shifts and even cleaning the apartment at 2 a.m., which my family really couldn't understand. I also started coming up with big business ideas to rescue our finances, but my relatives just brushed them off as unrealistic.
Did these symptoms start only after the family/work stress, and have they mainly made you feel upset or unable to cope rather than unusually energized or more productive than usual?

Yes, everything really escalated about a month ago once the pressure from my family and work built up. While I definitely feel overwhelmed and unable to cope now, I also had periods where I felt incredibly energized and driven to do a million things at once—like taking extra shifts and cleaning at 2 a.m.—before crashing into feeling exhausted and miserable.
Before this month, have you ever had a similar period of unusually high energy, less need for sleep, racing thoughts, or risky/overconfident behavior when you were not under major stress?

No, I've never experienced this kind of high energy, racing thoughts, or revved-up feeling before this past month. It all only started when the pressure from my family began, though I have had periods of feeling really down and depressed on and off for the last four months.
During this month, have these high-energy periods caused major problems at work, with relationships, or led to things like spending sprees, unsafe behavior, or needing to be hospitalized?

Yes, it’s actually caused huge problems and I feel so embarrassed about it. I've been written up twice at work for making mistakes and arguing with customers, and my sister stopped inviting me to family get-togethers because I keep causing scenes. My apartment has also become a complete disaster with piles of dirty dishes and laundry that I just can't keep up with anymore.

Did the symptoms start only after the stressful family/work situation, and have they mainly felt like being overwhelmed and unable to cope rather than having a clearly elevated or expansive mood most of the time?

While the intense, revved-up feelings got much worse over the last month after the family pressure started, I've actually had periods of heavy depression coming and going for about four months. It’s definitely not just feeling overwhelmed; I experience times where I feel "on top of the world" with a wired, high-energy feeling like a motor I can't shut off, which then swings into irritability and crying.
Have you ever had a full episode of depression that lasted at least 2 weeks, with low mood or loss of interest most of the day nearly every day?

Yes, I've been dealing with a heavy, drained depression for about the last four months where I completely lost interest in things I usually love, like hiking with my club or hanging out with friends. It has gotten much worse and more constant over the past few weeks, and now I mostly just feel like there's no point in doing anything anymore.
During the past month, have you felt depressed or lost interest most of the day nearly every day, or has the main problem been the high-energy, revved-up mood?

It honestly feels like a mix of both because I swing back and forth. Most of the past month has been dominated by that intense, wired, revved-up feeling where I can't shut down, but then I'll suddenly drop into heavy crashes. When that happens, I feel completely drained and depressed, and I lose all interest in things I usually love like hiking or my business ideas.
Over the past month, have you spent most of the time feeling depressed or losing interest, or most of the time feeling unusually energized, wired, or overly confident?

For most of the past month, I’ve spent the majority of the time feeling that wired, revved-up energy like a motor I can't shut off. I do crash into periods of feeling heavily depressed and completely losing interest in everything, which has gotten worse over the last couple of weeks. But overall, that constant, buzzing energy has been the most dominant feeling.
Over the past month, have you spent most of the time feeling depressed or losing interest, or most of the time feeling unusually energized, wired, or overly confident?

Over the past month, I have mostly felt that wired, angry, "revved-up" energy like a motor I can't shut off. But I also experience sudden swings where I drop into dark, heavy crashes and lose interest in everything. While those heavy, low feelings have been coming and going for about four months, this intense, constant revved-up feeling has really taken over during this last month.
Have you had a period of feeling depressed or losing interest nearly every day for at least 2 weeks, separate from the revved-up periods?

Yes, I've had those heavy, down periods coming and going for the last four months, and it has gotten much worse recently. It feels completely distinct from the revved-up times because when that high energy crashes, I am left feeling totally empty, numb, and completely uninterested in things I normally love, like hiking.
During your revved-up periods, have you ever had hallucinations or strongly believed things that other people said were not true, like being specially chosen, having unusual powers, or being watched?

Yes, during those highly energized times, I sometimes hear my uncle calling my name or see shadows in my room, and it feels so real that I pray or talk back to make it stop. I also truly believed I had a special mission to rescue my family's finances and reputation. These things only happen when I'm in that revved-up state, and they completely fade away when my mood crashes.

When you have the low, depressed periods, do you also hear or see things that aren’t there, or have strong beliefs that others say are not true? Or do those experiences only happen during the revved-up periods?

No, those experiences only happen when I'm in that revved-up, high-energy state. When I crash into those low, depressed periods, the voices and shadows fade away completely. I'm just left feeling empty, numb, and guilty instead.
When you hear or see things that aren’t there or have those unusual beliefs, do they happen only during the high-energy periods, or do they also occur when you are depressed?

They definitely only happen when I am in that revved-up, high-energy mode. When my mood crashes into that heavy, depressed feeling, those voices, shadows, and beliefs about rescuing my family completely fade away. During those low times, I'm just left feeling empty and guilty instead.
When the voices, shadows, or special beliefs happen, do they ever continue for at least 2 weeks when your mood is not high or revved up? Or do they only appear during those energized periods?

No, they never continue once my mood drops. They only appear when I'm in that high-energy, revved-up state. As soon as I crash into that heavy, empty feeling, those strange experiences completely fade away.
Have you ever had hallucinations or strong beliefs that others said were not true for at least 2 weeks when you were not feeling unusually energized or depressed?

No, never. Those experiences like hearing voices, seeing shadows, or believing I have a special mission only happen when I'm in that highly energized, revved-up state. When my mood is normal or when I crash, those things completely fade away.
When you have the voices, shadows, or special beliefs, do they ever continue for at least 2 weeks when your mood is not high, revved up, or depressed? Or do they only happen during the mood episodes?

No, they never happen when my mood is normal or stable. Those voices, shadows, and ideas about my mission only show up when I'm in that high, revved-up mode. Once that feeling fades or I crash, they completely go away and don't come back.

When you are not feeling high, revved up, or depressed, do you ever still hear voices, see shadows, or believe you have a special mission? Or do those experiences only happen during the mood episodes?

No, they only happen when I'm in that high, revved-up mode. When my mood crashes into that heavy, numb, and guilty feeling, those strange experiences completely fade away and I just feel empty. They never occur when my mood is normal or stable.
Do the voices, shadows, or special beliefs ever continue for at least 2 weeks when your mood is not high, depressed, or revved up? Or do they only happen during those mood episodes?

No, they never continue when my mood is normal or stable. Those voices, shadows, and beliefs about saving my family's finances only happen when I am in that revved-up, high-energy mode. Once my mood crashes into that heavy, numb feeling, those strange experiences completely fade away.
Have you ever had hallucinations or strongly unusual beliefs for at least 2 weeks when you were not feeling depressed, high, or revved up?

No, I have never had those experiences when I'm feeling normal. The voices, shadows, and strong beliefs about rescuing my family's finances only happen when I am in that highly revved-up, energetic mode. When I crash into depression or feel empty, they completely disappear.

Hearing the voices, seeing shadows, and believing I have a special mission to save my family's finances only happen when I am in that revved-up, high-energy mode. When my mood crashes or that wired energy goes away, those experiences completely fade.

When your mood is normal, do you ever still hear voices, see shadows, or believe you have a special mission, even for a few days at a time? Or do those experiences only happen when you are clearly high or depressed?

No, they never happen when my mood is normal, not even for a day. Those experiences only happen when I'm in that highly revved-up, can't-stop-moving mode. Once my mood crashes into that heavy, depressed feeling, those things completely fade away and I'm just left feeling empty and guilty.
Have you ever had voices, visions, or fixed unusual beliefs for at least 2 weeks when you were not feeling depressed, high, or revved up at all?

No, I have never had those experiences when my mood is normal. The voices, shadows, and strong beliefs about rescuing my family's finances only happen when I am in that revved-up, high-energy mode. As soon as that energy drops and my mood crashes, they completely fade away.
Have you ever had hallucinations or strong false beliefs for at least 2 weeks when you were not feeling depressed, high, or revved up at all?

No, I have never had those experiences when my mood was normal. The voices, shadows, and beliefs about saving my family only happen when I'm in that high-energy, revved-up mode. Once that energy crashes or my mood goes back to normal, they completely disappear.
During your depressed periods, do you also hear voices, see shadows, or believe you have a special mission, or do those experiences only happen when you feel high and revved up?
